metadata.conversionArithmetic: Decimal50 from published rational/decimal coefficients; final values rounded to binary64. Polar trigonometry is binary64.
metadata.gamutArithmetic: Independent binary64 translation of normative Local MINDE pseudocode, exact RGB cube inequalities, JND=0.02, epsilon=0.0001, final return of existing clipped value.
metadata.coefficientStatus: CSS section 19 is informative; normative conversion requirements and Local MINDE algorithm are cited separately.
metadata.rec2020Encoding: CSS snapshot uses BT.1886 gamma2.4 display encoding. The library's Rec.2020 video encoding instead uses BT.2020 OETF; compare linearRGB for gamut geometry.
metadata.maxChromaScope: First connected strict boundary on five fixed display rays; not an exhaustive global gamut proof.
